# netbox_ipsec_profile (Data Source)

An IPSec profile (vpn.ipsecprofile): an IKE policy and an IPSec policy applied together to tunnels.

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/vpn/ipsecprofile/):

> An [IPSec](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPsec) profile defines an [IKE policy](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/vpn/ikepolicy/), [IPSec policy](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/vpn/ipsecpolicy/), and IPSec mode used for establishing an IPSec tunnel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_ipsec_profile" "test" {
  name = "test-ipsec_profile"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `ike_policy_id` (Number) Id of the IKE policy.
- `ipsec_policy_id` (Number) Id of the IPSec policy.
- `mode` (String) IPSec mode. One of: esp, ah.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
